rules.rationale: Base equation for the mathematical accumulator summary sumSquaresFrom on an empty ValSeq.
Recursive equation defining sumSquaresFrom by adding the squared ceiling of the head and continuing over the tail.
Base equation for the structural helper lastFrom on an empty ValSeq.
Recursive equation defining lastFrom by carrying the current head value through the remaining ValSeq.

Its loop-state rewrite and freshness condition are first proved by SUM-SQUARES-LOOP-SPEC.loop-correct against SUM-SQUARES-VERIFICATION-BASE, which excludes this rule, before prove.sh compiles the full module containing it for the downstream function proof.
